dapps.name: Test dapp
dapps.summary: Connect, read the head block, sign a message, send KOIN
dapps.description: The wallet's own test page. It has no wallet code of its own and uses window.kondor for everything, exactly as a Koinos dapp would.

dapps.name: Koinos Fund System
dapps.description: The community fund: read the proposals asking for KOIN, see how the vote stands, and vote with your account's KOIN and VHP. The site connects to this wallet through window.kondor.

dapps.name: KoinDX
dapps.summary: Swap and pool tokens on Koinos

dapps.name: Vortex Bridge
dapps.description: Move KOIN, ETH, USDT and USDC between Koinos and Ethereum. Connects to this wallet through window.kondor; the Ethereum side needs an Ethereum wallet.

dapps.name: KoinosScan
dapps.description: Transactions, accounts and tokens on mainnet. (Harbinger transactions still open on koinosblocks.)

dapps.name: Fogata v2
dapps.summary: Mining pools: stake KOIN and VHP
dapps.description: Community-run Koinos mining pools (version 2, hosted on KoinScan): stake KOIN or VHP into a pool, unstake, and swap KOIN and VHP in place. The v1 site is fogata.io.

dapps.name: Koinos
dapps.description: News, documentation and links for the Koinos blockchain.

dapps.name: Koinos AI
dapps.summary: KAI, a local-first AI with a Koinos network
dapps.description: Chat, memory and agents that run locally or on the decentralised Koinos AI network. The app needs a Koinos AI account.
